messages:
Maya: Heads-up: seeing gaps when linking traces to Loki logs for GPU preempt events in eu-west1. Kibana shows traces with span_id 0xabc123 but Loki returns nothing for the same trace_id. Anyone else?

Jon: saw something similar during last surge, might be index rotation or relabel mismatch. what's the trace id? paste sample?

Maya: trace_id=af3e9b7c4d12, root span id 7f4d. Kibana query I ran: trace.id: "af3e9b7c4d12" -> shows spans. In Loki I ran: {job="gpu-runtime"} |= "trace_id=af3e9b7c4d12" and got nothing.

Terry: can you try a looser LogQL: {app="node-gpu"} |~ "trace_id.*af3e9b7c" | line_format "{{.message}}" ? sometimes the field gets mangled by promtail pipeline.

Maya: ran that, still no hits. Prometheus shows gpu_preempt_total{region="eu-west1"} spiked at the same time though. Could be agent-side formatting or an ingest drop.

Ivan: check loki_ingester_protos_dropped_total and any pushgateway errors in the same timeframe. Was there a grafana alert?

Jon: Grafana recorded loki_ingester_protos_dropped_total +320 at 2026-03-15T14:02Z. Also noticed s3 backend had a handful of 5xx around then. Coldstore writes were delayed.

Maya: FWIW Kibana returns spans with source: "agent-collector-eu-west1" and the raw span messages include trace=0xaf3e9b7c4d12 (note the 0x prefix) whereas our Loki searches used trace_id=af3e9b7c4d12 (no 0x). Might be a normalization mismatch.

Terry: good find — promtail/ingest pipelines historically had a relabel step that preserves 0x prefix. If some agents send 0x and others don't, we end up with split indexes. Check the promtail pipeline regex.

Jon: found the promtail config in repo:
```
- action: replace
  source_labels: [__line]
  target_label: trace_id
  regex: '.*trace=(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+).*'
  replacement: '$1'
```
That keeps the 0x, so searches without it miss lines.

Maya: pushed a quick canary promtail patch to strip optional 0x: regex '0x?(?P<tid>[0-9a-fA-F]+)' and replacement '$tid'. Deployed to eu-west1 canary hosts.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started for promtail config update to eu-west1 (canary).

Ivan: after deploy, try re-running Loki queries with both IDs: {job="gpu-runtime"} |= "af3e9b7c4d12" OR |= "0xaf3e9b7c4d12". Also check loki_client_ingest_errors for the earlier drop window.

Maya: re-run after canary — Loki now returns the agent flush and preempt stack lines. Correlation works: trace spans in Kibana map to logs in Loki. Looks like a combination of ingest drops + trace-id normalization caused the gap.

Jon: nice. Follow-ups: (1) propagate promtail regex change to all regions, (2) add unit/integration test for trace-id normalization in the log pipeline, (3) tweak loki_ingester_protos_dropped_total alert to fire earlier (warn at lower threshold) and add runbook. I'll open PRs for 1 and 2 and a Grafana dashboard tweak for 3.

Terry: filing postmortem doc: https://app.docs/redwood/postmortems/pm-gpu-trace-correlation-eu-west1

Maya: thanks team :raised_hands:
